sceneConcept: A provisional design for a forty-seven-year-old Chinese ordinary acquaintance with an interest in old machinery stands alone against a transparent background. Short black hair greys at the temples, with brown eyes, light stubble and a relaxed modest smile. He wears a weathered brown work jacket open over a faded blue shirt with rolled sleeves, charcoal trousers, a plain belt and brown work boots. One old-fashioned analog wristwatch supplies a quiet everyday mechanical hint. One hand rests in a trouser pocket while the other hangs relaxed. Soft even frontal studio light keeps him unassuming. Visual refresh: a worn trench coat over a waistcoat and rolled work shirt with an old mechanical part.
